events.source_text: They walked down Diagon Alley, back through the wall, back through the Leaky Cauldron,
‘We’re going to get yeh a new wand, Harry. You can’t go to Hogwarts without a wand.’
Hagrid handed Harry a large cage that held a beautiful snowy owl, fast asleep with her head under her wing.
Harry entered Madam Malkin’s shop alone, feeling nervous.
‘Hello,’ said the boy, ‘Hogwarts, too?’ ‘Yes,’ said Harry.
They stopped to buy parchment and quills. Harry cheered up a bit when he found a bottle of ink that changed color as you wrote.
A tinkling bell rang somewhere in the depths of the shop as they stepped inside.
‘Good afternoon,’ said a soft voice. Harry jumped.
Mr. Ollivander handed Harry a box wrapped in brown paper.
Mr. Ollivander bowed them from his shop.
